title: Nobody claps for these. *Everyone notices* if you can't.

items.head: Light a fire
items.sub: No lighter fluid. Dry kindling, small sticks, then logs.

items.head: Change a flat tire
items.sub: Practice once in your driveway before you need it.

items.head: Cook 3 real meals
items.sub: Eggs, a steak, one pasta. No delivery app.

items.head: Fix the small stuff
items.sub: Unclog a drain, hang a shelf, reset a breaker.

items.head: Order and pay smoothly
items.sub: Know what you want, handle the bill, tip and go.

text: Competence never gets applause. *Its absence* gets noticed in seconds.
